text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And finally, the "Midsummer Sand Beach 
Dirt Festival" begins!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I-It's packed~! All that advertising 
really paid off, huh. 
Even I'm starting to feel a tiny bit 
nervous... maybe!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
In front of this many people...! 
Ugh, maybe I should write cheat sheets on 
my hand?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, sounds good! 
...Oh, wait☆ I have a favor to ask 
everyone, though!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Can Falco do a little opening act? 
Just one song isn't gonna be enough for 
me~☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sounds like a great idea. 
If it's just one song, I can easily adjust 
the schedule—!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do... Can I go closer to 
the front? 
This is my first time at a festival. Do I 
say... "Wassup" or something...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —*Vroooom*!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Catch me by the water's edge☆ It's Smart 
Falcon! 
Eveeeeryone, repeat after Falco~! "Yaaay!"

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Yaaay...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: One more time! "Yaaaay!!"

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“Shai!”...♪ “Shai-shai!”...♪ Looking good♡ 
Here we go♪ "Falco! Setting her sights on 
the absolute center!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Standing in positiooon zerooo~♪ 
Ranked numberrr oneee~♪"

text_block_list.name: Whole Venue
text_block_list.text:
"Absolute! (Absolute!) 
Proposition! (Proposition!) 
'Cause I'm an idol! (Woo-hoo!)"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...!! Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With this atmosphere, we'll definitely be 
fine...! 
You two, it's almost time to go!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this momentum going and hype 
things up! 
We've got this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with the excitement at its peak, the 
opening remarks came to a successful 
close. 
As for each of the event segments...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnngggghhh---!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute! She picks up the pace! She 
takes the lead! 
Her winning streak is unstoppable~~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. I'm a professional 
racehorse Umamusume after all. 
I can run as many times as it takes, so 
bring it on as much as you like!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san is stealing the spotlight! But 
I've got something too... Ta-da! 
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Mega-Mega-Mega Great 
Fortune~~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Azure Dragon, Black Tortoise, Vermilion 
Bird, White Tiger... The harmony of the 
Four Auspicious Beasts! 
Ah, it's a dream-like, ultimate happy 
space...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Health, wealth, romance, career, warding 
off evil, and everything else! 
May good fortune come to eveeeeryone!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And that's all! That was our guest, Smart 
Falcon-san! 
Ehehe, that was some wonderful singing, 
wasn't it~♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So then, for the next track, here's a 
slightly more relaxed song♪ 
Please listen to... "Nishikionuma 
Memories".

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Perfekt... Right on schedule.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *Deflaaaaating*......

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work. 
That concludes all of your appearances, 
Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: *Yaaaaawn*... Sleeeeepy...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Her battery's completely drained. Please 
speak in Japanese... Woah! 
Heh... Were you nervous?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I always am, you know? And that's fine. 
Tension is important, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You certainly didn't look it. 
...You're always like this.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... That's what being an Umadol is 
all about☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the wildly exciting festival came 
to an end. 
Once the tear-down was finished, the 
performers and staff all collapsed into a 
deep sleep—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, our final day here... was a 
full day off!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! It's so cold! 
And saltyyy!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It feels sooo good~♪ 
Nothing beats this refreshing feeling 
after a job well done.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Right...?! Thank you, everyone! 
We're gonna play our hearts out today! 
Hyahhh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaahhh~♪ The absolute beeeest summer 
ever♡ Right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The sea in Germany remains cold even 
in summer, so this kind of enjoyment is 
quite refreshing. 
I've experienced yet another aspect of 
Japanese culture to report back to my 
parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Gazing at the sea and sky while bathed in 
the ocean breeze like this... 
it fills me with Fernweh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, even though we've already come 
this far~?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is true, but... 
don't you feel as though we could go much, 
much further?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? ...Ah, let's go abroad together 
someday then! 
I feel like I'd never get lost with you 
around, Flash-san~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That sounds lovely. ...A warm country 
would be nice. 
I would like to visit a place even hotter 
than Japan.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a promise then! 
Ah! But scheduling can wait. Right now, 
it's vacation time♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course. 
My schedule for the entire day today is 
'to relax with you,' so—
